evidence.quote: A Q-Former (Querying Transformer) is a lightweight transformer module that extracts a fixed-size set of learned representations from variable-length input embeddings.
The Alphagenome Q-former has 32 query vectors

answers.value: Q-Former (Querying Transformer), a lightweight transformer module with 32 query vectors

evidence.quote: These query vectors interact with the input embeddings through cross-attention, effectively 'querying' the input for the most task-relevant information.

answers.value: Query vectors cross-attend to the input embeddings

evidence.quote: Stage 1 of training simultaneously trains each modality-specific Q-former model to align its input embeddings with shared textual captions, allowing each to learn modality-specific attention patterns that are relevant to the shared text in different ways.
The Stage 2 training loss is next-token-prediction with the LLM's weights frozen, so the loss only updates the projection weights, W proj, the Master Qformer weights, and the Stage 1 Qformer weights.

answers.value: Trained/updated during pretraining

evidence.quote: the query tokens cross-attend with both the instruction tokens and self-attend with each other

answers.value: Query tokens self-attend with each other

evidence.quote: The master Q-former model is a 6-layer InstructBLIP-style [19] Q-Former

answers.value: 6 layers

evidence.quote: The master Q-former model is a 6-layer InstructBLIP-style [19] Q-Former that fuses the Stage 1 modality-specific tokens with a natural-language instruction, and produces 32 refined query tokens for the LLM.
It contains N m = 32 learnable meta-query vectors of its own.

answers.value: 6-layer InstructBLIP-style Q-Former with 32 refined query tokens

evidence.quote: At each forward pass the meta-query tokens and the tokenised instruction are concatenated into a single sequence; the query tokens cross-attend with both the instruction tokens and self-attend with each other (mimicking the InstructBLIP concatenation trick), and cross-attend to the layer-normalised Stage 1 visual tokens every two transformer layers.

answers.value: Query tokens cross-attend to instruction tokens and layer-normalised Stage 1 visual tokens, and self-attend with each other
